integrity: The proof uses only the published witnessed Gödel modal semantics: box and diamond values are attained extrema. Because depth-one modal scopes are propositional, induced restriction leaves each retained scope value unchanged, making equality of the restricted extremum equivalent to retaining an extremal witness. The sharp family is an explicit finite crisp model. The primary full text and the witnessed-crisp predecessor were inspected at their finite-model and witness-generation arguments.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns a fixed root and finite formula families of modal depth at most one. It does not extend the simple transversal criterion to nested modalities, does not preserve values simultaneously at every retained world, and does not claim an efficient algorithm for minimum transversal computation.
title: Exact witness-core theorem for the one-step fragment of GW
